name: nonApi_getUserInviteCodeByPublicHasherId
description: Internal, no auth. Called only by the EmailInviteCode Azure Function (api/Endpoints/EmailInviteCode.cs) — never by the app. Resolves the live hasher (Removed = 0) from their public hasher id (identification only), makes sure they hold a compliant invite code via HC6.nonApi_ensureUserInviteCode WITHOUT rotation (this path must not invalidate a code the user may just have been sent), and returns their email address and the code, so the function can send the invite without the client ever seeing the address. Empty rowset when the hasher is unknown or removed.

parameters.name: publicHasherId
parameters.description: The hasher's public-facing UUID from HC.Hasher.PublicHasherId — typically obtained by the client from hcapp_findHashersByHashName. Table column is UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL.

rowsets.name: HasherInviteDetails
rowsets.description: Returns 0 or 1 rows. 0 rows when the hasher is not found or is removed (Removed != 0). 1 row with email and invite code when found. The C# caller must handle the 0-row case.

columns.name: Email
columns.description: HC.Hasher.Email — the hasher's email address. Table column is NVARCHAR(250) NOT NULL. The C# caller uses this to address the invite email.

columns.name: InviteCode
columns.description: HC.Hasher.ResetCode with the 'URC:' prefix stripped — a six-letter code, guaranteed compliant by nonApi_ensureUserInviteCode just before the read (unless its ten-attempt generation failed, which it logs).

sideEffects: EXEC HC6.nonApi_ensureUserInviteCode @userId (no rotation) — UPDATEs HC.Hasher.ResetCode / ResetCodeLastUpdated only when the current code is non-compliant (e.g. the '######' default); fires the Hasher triggers.

codeSmells.issue: SP body not wrapped in TRY/CATCH
codeSmells.detail: Lines 27-39 have no TRY/CATCH; an error in the lookups reaches EmailInviteCode as a raw exception with no HC.ErrorLog row from this SP.
@publicHasherId (line 2) has no SQL default. The one C# caller always supplies it.

breakingChanges: HC5 lived in the HC schema (HC.nonApi_getUserInviteCodeByPublicHasherId). HC6 moves it to the HC6 schema. Any C# code referencing the HC schema name directly must be updated.
1.1.0 (2026-09-07): calls nonApi_ensureUserInviteCode before reading, so the '######' column default is no longer returned as a code. Rowset unchanged.
